content:
Are you entering your account password rather than a generated "App password". This could be the reason the password is not accepted.

Many email providers now require an "App password" to be used for security reasons. See the AOL's guide linked below.

https://help.aol.com/articles/create-and-manage-app-password

If your account is connecting using imap, oauth 2.0 is the recommended and more secure authentication method.

content:
The "user is authenticated but not connected" issue is usually due to temporary Microsoft server issues. The server is not allowing the imap connection. The app usually successfully reconnects again a few hours once MS resolve their issue.

Do you use a VPN to connect?
creator: platform34

content:
Thanks for the reply!

I do use a VPN on my smartphone, but it is set up with split tunneling (per-app proxy), and Thunderbird is excluded from it — meaning it connects directly without the VPN.

Also, I doubt this is purely a temporary Microsoft server issue, because the authentication failure and the "User is authenticated but not connected" notification happen multiple times every single day.
